disorder-name.detail: Alzheimer's disease; diagnosed per NIA-AA criteria; clinical cohort from Dataset 2 (MCAD); NM applied to this cohort.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Dataset 2 comprised 257 normal control (NC) participants, 257 patients with MCI, and 295 patients with AD from the MCAD (Multicenter Alzheimer Disease Imaging Consortium) dataset."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Dataset 2 is the MCAD (Multicenter Alzheimer Disease Imaging Consortium), 7 sites, used as the primary clinical cohort for AD.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Dataset 2 comprised 257 normal control (NC) participants, 257 patients with MCI, and 295 patients with AD from the MCAD (Multicenter Alzheimer Disease Imaging Consortium) dataset."

age.detail: Mean and SD from Table 1 (main paper). Min/max not explicitly reported; MCAD inclusion criteria stated 50–90 years (Supplemental Method S1). No combined calculation needed (single dataset).

sex.detail: F/M=172/123 from Table 1. Percentages calculated from counts (172/295=58.3%, 123/295=41.7%).

disorder-name.detail: Mild cognitive impairment; clinical cohort from Dataset 2 (MCAD, n=257) and Dataset 3 (ADNI, n=184); NM applied to both datasets. Total MCI n=441.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "mapping the deviations of the brain characteristics for individuals from multiple datasets, including 295 patients with AD, 441 patients with MCI, and 1160 normal control participants"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Dataset 2 (MCAD, n=257 MCI) and Dataset 3 (ADNI, n=184 MCI). ADNI used for replication/longitudinal analysis.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Dataset 2 comprised ... 257 patients with MCI ... from the MCAD ... Dataset 3 included 259 NC participants and 184 patients with MCI from the ADNI"

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD calculated from MCAD MCI (n=257, mean=68.6, SD=8.9) and ADNI MCI (n=184, mean=72.0, SD=7.8). Weighted mean=(257×68.6+184×72.0)/441=70.02; pooled SD=sqrt((256×8.9²+183×7.8²)/439)=8.46. Min/max not reported.
